en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Cava dei Tirreni
en.summary: A plague is said to have ceased after a priest blessed the city with the Blessed Sacrament.
en.body: During the plague epidemic of 1656, a priest of Cava dei Tirreni carried the Blessed Sacrament from the hill of Monte Castello to bless the stricken city below; local tradition holds that the epidemic ceased soon after.
